title: keybindings.json
description: The person's own keys, layered over the defaults (KEY-07, D-170). In the app's data folder, one per device.

command.description: A command's ID. A leading minus removes that default chord from the command instead of adding one.

key.description: A chord: modifiers (Mod is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere), then one key, joined with +.

platform.description: Only on this platform. Without it, everywhere.
